_comment: Core-specific. The main CPU's view of the machine, from MAME promat/gstream.cpp gstream_32bit_map (272-287). Read by mame_capture.py, write_timing.py and the E1 trace tools. Addresses are hex strings, inclusive. x2222 and x2222o use x2222_32bit_map (366-383): the base 'x2222'.
_wtap_comment: Scroll registers, write-only (scrollx_w/scrolly_w, umask 0xffff0000: the value is bits 31:16). Layer n is drawn from VRAM + n * 0x400 bytes; 2 is drawn first, 0 last.
_sweep_regions_comment: VRAM interleaves the tilemaps (bits 31:16 of each dword) and the sprite list (bits 15:0); the third value is the byte-lane mask a write must overlap to count (wtiming.lua).

io_space._comment: AS_IO of the E1-32X: 32-bit data, 13 address bits, the address unit is a dword (e132xs.cpp 163, shift -2); the CPU's I/O address is its effective address >> 13 (e132xs.cpp 1555). gstream_io 354-363.
io_space.name: io

x2222._comment: x2222_32bit_map (366-383): no palette RAM (16-bit direct colour), RAM at 0x40000000, scroll registers at 0x4fa00000-0x4ff00000, boot ROM 1 MB from 0xfff00000.
